series_parent_check.name: series_parent_check
series_parent_check.value: ("series"."kind" = 'diproduksi' and "series"."parent_series_id" is null) or ("series"."kind" = 'turunan' and "series"."parent_series_id" is not null)

plan_results_defect_check.name: plan_results_defect_check
plan_results_defect_check.value: "plan_results"."defect_qty" = 0 or ("plan_results"."defect_reason" is not null and "plan_results"."defect_action" is not null and "plan_results"."defect_action" in ('repair','reject'))
